sloka: स कृत्वा पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां शासने पृथिवीपतिः ।सुरलोकमितो जेतुमुद्योगमकरोन्नृपः ।। ७.६७.६ ॥
transliteration: sa kṛtvā pṛthivīṁ kṛtsnāṁ śāsane pṛthivīpatiḥ ।suralokamito jetumudyogamakaronnṛpaḥ ।। 7.67.6 ॥

translations.english: Having brought the entire earth under his rule, that king, the lord of the earth, then made an effort to conquer the world of the gods from here.
